components.name: Control Room / UI
components.purpose: Operator control surface for data, research, Factory, Optimizer, Scientist, Challenger and Champion workflows.

components.name: MTF Data Foundation
components.purpose: Collect, normalize, derive, align, audit and bind canonical MTF data.

components.name: Strategy Optimizer
components.purpose: Run native MT5 parameter search and register qualified Strategy Challengers.

components.name: Research Kernel
components.purpose: Evaluate candidates with causal CV/CPCV, KPI gates, stress, sample policy and research memory.

components.name: Model Lab
components.purpose: Define model families, train/evaluate candidates, govern capacity and export ONNX.

components.name: Champion Factory
components.purpose: Orchestrate Discovery through Fresh Forward and register Model Challengers.

components.name: Scientist
components.purpose: Read evidence, reason about research and propose bounded legal experiments using optional guarded Python analysis.

components.name: Release / Challenger / Champion Governance
components.purpose: Maintain release identity, eligibility and explicit promotion lifecycle.

components.name: EA / MT5 Runtime
components.purpose: Execute inherited seven-family strategy and ONNX/shadow runtime under explicit live-trading controls.

components.name: Acceptance / Evidence
components.purpose: Run local cumulative gates and verify candidate-bound external proof.

data_flows.meaning: Native M5/M15/H1/H4 inputs are resolved to one broker symbol and causally normalized.
Validated datasets, alignment and lineage feed strategy/model research.
Eligible optimizer winner is registered as Strategy Challenger, never auto-promoted.
Candidate evidence progresses through deterministic lifecycle gates.
Qualified Factory winner is registered as Model Challenger before any Champion promotion.
Advisory proposals are admitted only through deterministic legality/capacity/scientific checks.
Only explicit accepted release/Champion authority may change production deployment identity.
Executed evidence constrains what may be claimed as PASS.

external_boundaries.name: MetaTrader 5 / Strategy Tester
external_boundaries.contract: External execution/data authority; required Owner evidence for production closure.

external_boundaries.name: MetaEditor
external_boundaries.contract: External compile authority; semantic log + fresh EX5 + provenance, not return code alone.

external_boundaries.name: NVIDIA/CUDA
external_boundaries.contract: External accelerator capability; no silent CPU equivalence when CUDA proof is required.

external_boundaries.name: LLM providers
external_boundaries.contract: Advisory Scientist dependency; provider failure cannot override deterministic Factory authority.

external_boundaries.name: Browser/Streamlit
external_boundaries.contract: Rendered UI behavior requires runtime/browser acceptance where required.
